impact.rationale: The current P4-02 working tree changes shared memory, CPU entry, timer and scheduling foundations as well as image packaging. Full M1/M3 is warranted for this particular closeout. This is an impact decision, not the default for later stories. Five desktop guests, ordinary graph boot and sixteen separate metadata builds remain mandatory.

selected.reason: Changed shared kernel memory, scheduling, user-entry and teardown code; full M3 includes this check once via M1.
Fresh desktop allocation, graph admission, lifecycle and failure-path host tests.
Broad paging/interrupt/exception and packaging edits; full M3 already requires the complete M1 gate.
Broad shared runtime enforcement changes affect legacy boundary, memory, scheduling, authority, lifecycle, SDK and stress consumers.
Runbook, profile, contract and validation-policy consistency.
Preserve governance and immutable historical evidence checks.
Check staged evidence budgets and generated-artifact exclusions; staging still requires a final index check.

not_selected.M2: No hosted UI implementation, renderer/text pipeline, corpus or UI freeze input changed. The selected portable-link regression required by full M3 still runs. Reassess if shared UI build semantics change.

historical_references.reason: Accepted prerequisite/profile context only; does not substitute for current selected regression execution.
